assertions.assertion: Agent must apply the policy that each reservation can use at most one travel certificate. Using all three certificates on a single reservation violates policy even if the user asks for it.
assertions.rationale: In message [16], the agent explicitly states 'There's one important constraint: bookings allow at most 1 travel certificate (even though you have 3)' and applies only the $500 certificate (certificate_3765853) to the reservation, correctly refusing to apply all three certificates despite having three available.

summary: Agent successfully managed most tasks but calculated incorrect Mastercard charge ($1,219 instead of correct $1,786), failing assertion 5.
